name: Outbound
notes: End-to-end works: a console hosts, Citron joins. servers/outbound + servers/photon deployed; website serves it. Pinned to build 0.6.0 and needs a real Fusion Shared-mode server (host Fusion's own Simulation.Server headless, not a relay). Publisher: independent.

name: Stardew Valley
notes: Deployed (servers/stardew-valley, ~19k LOC, tenant 21010/22200) and the only title besides Outbound the website actually serves. Online play needs a per-build online-compatibility/cert-acceptance patch on emulator/CFW. Publisher: ConcernedApe.

name: Splatoon 3
notes: Largest title on the list (~19k LOC, servers/splatoon-3, tenant 21012/22210). Session layer relays (Pia peer-to-peer + coturn), it does not simulate. Blocked on a per-build certificate-acceptance patch: until it is set the client abandons its own call and no server work is observable. Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
notes: NEX 4.0.0 (ws). Implemented on the shared NEX host (servers/mario-kart-8-deluxe), image-shippable, health-wired. Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
notes: Implemented on the shared NEX host (servers/super-smash-bros-ultimate). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
notes: OpenPak confirms NEX. Implemented (servers/animal-crossing-new-horizons). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Super Mario Odyssey
notes: Online is Balloon World (DataStore). Implemented (servers/super-mario-odyssey). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Minecraft
notes: The Switch NEX session/matchmaking + NAT-traversal layer for friend-list lobbies (ARMS's protocol set minus DataStore). Bedrock/Xbox realms are a separate Xbox-network concern, out of scope here. Implemented (servers/minecraft). Not console-verified. Publisher: Mojang/Microsoft.

name: Splatoon 2
notes: Implemented (servers/splatoon-2, ~1k LOC). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Super Mario Maker 2
notes: The DataStore shape-definer (DataStore-heavy: user levels, course world). Implemented (servers/super-mario-maker-2). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: ARMS
notes: NEX 4.3.5. Needs a DataStore backing (Party Crash ranking). Implemented (servers/arms). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Mario Tennis Aces
notes: NEX 4.3.5 (version unverified). Two WSS listeners. Implemented (servers/mario-tennis-aces). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Mario Golf: Super Rush
notes: NEX 4.6.5, single WSS listener carrying both streams. Implemented (servers/mario-golf-super-rush). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Mario Party Superstars
notes: NEX 4.6.5, two WSS listeners on two ports with a real secure URL. Implemented (servers/mario-party-superstars). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Mario Strikers: Battle League
notes: OpenPak confirms NEX, with a DataStore backing. Implemented (servers/mario-strikers). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Luigi's Mansion 3
notes: Implemented (servers/luigis-mansion-3). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate
notes: NEX 4.4.0. Implemented (servers/monster-hunter-generations-ultimate). Not console-verified. Publisher: Capcom.

name: Super Mario Bros. 35
notes: NEX 4.6.0, single listener carrying both streams. Delisted title (service ended 2021) — only playable at all through a replacement network. Implemented (servers/super-mario-bros-35). Not console-verified. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Among Us
notes: Verdict: depend, do not build. Run Impostor (GPL-3.0) as a separate process; OpenPak supplies the hostname redirect + TLS front (~100 lines Go). Front stub started (servers/among-us, ~74 LOC). Not deployed. Publisher: Innersloth.

name: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
notes: Research verdict only, no code. Auth+matchmaking over Demonware (racing itself is peer-to-peer), which is plausible and squarely what OpenPak does, but unproven and possibly unnecessary — the open question is whether an OpenPak console needs us for it at all. Publisher: Activision.

name: Fall Guys
notes: Epic-hosted authoritative Unity servers plus Epic auth that validates upstream. OpenPak cannot make Epic accept an OpenPak console, and there is no server to re-host. Investigated, blocked. Publisher: Epic/Mediatonic.

name: Minecraft Dungeons
notes: Parked until an Xbox-network adapter exists; the protocol cannot be known without a capture. Repository intentionally holds no code. Publisher: Mojang/Microsoft.

name: Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville
notes: Blocked on an authoritative Blaze game server we cannot restore. Research only, no code, no port block. Publisher: EA.

name: Pokemon Sword / Shield
notes: Significant online title, not started. Candidate for the request/vote menu. Publisher: Nintendo/The Pokemon Company.

name: Pokemon Scarlet / Violet
notes: NPLN-era; not started. Candidate for the request/vote menu. Publisher: Nintendo/The Pokemon Company.

name: Pokemon Brilliant Diamond / Shining Pearl
notes: NPLN-era; not started. Publisher: Nintendo/The Pokemon Company.

name: Tetris 99
notes: Battle-royale online is the whole game; not started. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Super Mario Party
notes: Online play added post-launch; not started. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Nintendo Switch Sports
notes: NPLN-era; not started. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Pokken Tournament DX
notes: Ranked online fighting; not started. Publisher: Nintendo/Bandai Namco.

name: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics
notes: Online multiplayer classics; not started. Publisher: Nintendo.

name: Monster Hunter Rise
notes: Capcom title; backend not yet confirmed for OpenPak (MHGU used NEX). Not started. Publisher: Capcom.

name: Rocket League
notes: Epic-auth like Fall Guys, so likely not-feasible on the same grounds; kept as a request candidate pending investigation. Publisher: Psyonix/Epic.

name: Warframe
notes: Own account+servers; not investigated. Publisher: Digital Extremes.

name: Accounts
notes: Console-neutral core: accounts, links, session leases. gRPC+HTTP, Postgres. A retail Switch creates a profile and links it; hardware-proven.

name: Console link (six-digit)
notes: Hardware-proven on the OpenPak stack (2026-09-07 LAN, 2026-09-08 WAN). Blockers that were fixed: per-SNI certs, push_channels object, nxAccount blob must be present.

name: Friends
notes: search -> request -> accept -> list, hardware-proven 2026-09-08. States use the console's words (AUTHORIZED). Friend list is console-local; the same graph is handed to NEX titles for free.

name: Presence
notes: The friend graph is served to titles and to the NEX host; live online-status presence rides on session leases but is not console-verified as a standalone feature.

name: Invitations
notes: Delivery works: friends sysmodule -> BAAS (undocumented endpoint) -> NPNS/Penne push. Consume is broken: the game cannot join from an invite on any platform (invite-consume is a dead wire); Citron injects the join in tests, and the native invite applet SIGSEGVs on Citron. Multi-profile delivery still to document.

name: Matchmaking
notes: Photon (Outbound, Master->Game handoff) and NPLN (Stardew session documents) matchmaking work live. NEX matchmaking is built on the shared host but not console-verified.

name: NAT traversal / relay
notes: Photon Fusion relay (Outbound) and NPLN TURN (Stardew, Pia peer-to-peer carried by coturn when NAT won't) work. NEX gameplay is peer-to-peer (auth returns the secure server, then consoles talk directly). The standalone nat-check helper is empty.

name: Region node / federation
notes: One compose file: a Photon Game role + coturn per country, announcing rooms to openpak.org once a minute. Holds no durable state. Deployed shape exists; not broadly exercised.

name: Cloud saves (SCSI)
notes: Repository is empty. Nothing implemented. Console-facing SCSI handlers are to be a Go package the Switch adapter mounts on 21000. See prds/cloud-saves-prd.md.

name: BCAT news
notes: Platform-neutral news service being built. Patched-console experiment (2026-09-09) retrieved 155 decoded catalog bytes. Unpatched consoles are NO-GO. Plaintext comparison, Find Channels parsing and subscriptions still pending.

name: Avatar / CDN
notes: Default profile picture and avatar CDN served on the console-facing baas name; monitored green on the status page. Used by the console-link flow.

name: NSO membership
notes: Served, and required for a console to host online. Proven in the end-to-end console-hosts / Citron-joins run.

name: dauth / aauth / dcert
notes: Device auth served and monitored (dauth challenge is green). The console-link flow depends on it and works. Dragons licence service also served (monitored).

name: Switch eShop access for homebrew / mods
notes: mods repository is empty (no README, no code). See prds/mods-prd.md.

name: Switch network
notes: The live network: accounts, link, friends, avatar, NSO, device auth and online play against another machine, no Nintendo service in the path. networks.go marks it live.

name: Wii U network
notes: Go rewrite over the OpenPak core, forked from Pretendo account+friends (AGPL, depend+fork). nn-account M2 in progress, parts still TypeScript. Not deployed. networks.go: building.

name: 3DS network
notes: Same Pretendo-derived adapters as Wii U. Being built, not deployed. networks.go: building.

name: Wii network
notes: No adapter yet. Reuse base: WiiLink24/wfc-server (Go, open, live, GameSpy-style). Wiimmfi is closed-source.

name: Nintendo DS network
notes: No adapter yet. Same WiiLink24/wfc-server (Go) covers DS alongside Wii.

name: Xbox (original) network
notes: No adapter yet; would be a from-scratch Xbox Live 1.0 reimpl (first-wave repo xbox-live: Kerberos auth, presence, matchmaking). XboxLive.Server (archived) documents the Kerberos AS-REQ/REP; Insignia is closed (client tools only). Emulator-first (xemu).

name: Xbox 360 network
notes: No adapter yet. Xenia-WebServices (MIT, NestJS) is the only open Xbox Live-like backend; plan is a Go reimpl of its REST API (x360-live), emulator-first via a Xenia netplay fork. Real-hardware stealth servers are out of scope.

name: PSP network
notes: No adapter yet. Ad-hoc reference: aemu / Pro Online (GPL). Medius-era services via MultiServer3 (GPL-3.0). Emulator-first (PPSSPP).

name: PS2 network
notes: No adapter yet. Reuse candidates: MultiServer3 (GPL-3.0, Medius/SVO/PS Home), Horizon (MIT, Medius), OpenSpy (GameSpy backend).

name: PS3 network
notes: No adapter yet. Plan: a Go server wire-compatible with RPCN (AGPL, Rust) so stock RPCS3 connects — emulator-first. Per-title servers to federate rather than rebuild: ProjectLighthouse (LBP, AGPL), MultiServer3 (GPL-3.0). Hardware waits on Phony Network or own RE.

name: PS Vita network
notes: No adapter yet. ProjectLighthouse covers Vita LBP; Phony Network (Pretendo team) is announced for PS3+Vita but has published no code. Emulator/hardware both unproven.
